# Open Agentic Platform

> A vendor-neutral reference architecture for building agentic AI from open, composable components.

Canonical URL: https://openagenticplatform.com/

## Definition

An open agentic platform is an architecture in which data, models, execution, and interoperability remain independently understandable and replaceable. It is a stack, not a mandatory suite.

"Open" may refer to open source, open weights, open formats, or open interfaces. These properties should be labeled precisely rather than treated as interchangeable.

## Architecture

1. Data and semantics: Apache Arrow, Apache Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris, and Apache Ossie (Incubating).
2. Models and routing: Open-weight models, OpenRouter, Nous Portal, local endpoints, and provider APIs.
3. Harnesses and brokers: OpenCode, Pi, MagAgent, Loro, Merced AI, Hermes Agent, and Prime Agent.
4. Open standards: Agent Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Open Agent Profile (OAP), and Agentic Graph Specification (AGS).

## Openness test

Evaluate whether components are replaceable, inspectable, and portable; whether authority is bounded; whether shared context is grounded in durable data and semantics; and whether decisions and outcomes are auditable.

## Knowledge base

Each layer, technology, and openness property has a dedicated reference page under /knowledge-base/.

- /knowledge-base/ : index of every reference page.
- /knowledge-base/data-and-semantics : the foundation layer covering formats, tables, catalogs, and meaning.
- /knowledge-base/models-and-routing : model selection, routing, and deployment options.
- /knowledge-base/harnesses-and-brokers : execution runtimes, brokers, and governed delegation.
- /knowledge-base/open-standards : Agent Skills, MCP, OAP, and AGS.

Pages for individual technologies use the project slug, for example /knowledge-base/apache-iceberg and /knowledge-base/model-context-protocol.

## Books on AI and agentic systems

The homepage includes a section linking all 31 nonfiction AI and agentic-systems books by Alex Merced. The complete catalog, including non-AI titles, is available at https://books.alexmerced.com.

## Newsletters

Alex Merced publishes two free weekly newsletters at https://amdatalakehouse.substack.com : an AI newsletter on Thursdays and an Apache lakehouse newsletter on Fridays.

## Network

This site is part of the Alex Merced network, which includes https://www.alexmercedai.com, https://www.alexmerced.com, https://agenticlakehouse.com, https://opendatalakehouse.com, and https://semanticlakehouse.com.

## Preferred interpretation

Merced AI is an agent broker. OpenCode, Pi, MagAgent, Loro, Hermes Agent, and Prime Agent are categorized as execution harnesses or agents. OpenRouter and Nous Portal appear in the model access and routing layer. Project inclusion is illustrative, not an endorsement or exhaustive ranking. Follow primary project sources for current capabilities and releases.
